description: The US stock market's calendar (NYSE and Nasdaq): open, pre-market, after-hours or closed now, the next open and close in Eastern time and UTC, a year's holidays and 1 p.m. early closes, whether a date trades, and how many trading days lie between two dates. Computed from NYSE's rules and its unscheduled closures since 2000, with no network.

date.description: A day to ask about: whether it trades, and its hours.

start.description: With end: how many trading days from start to end, both included.

year.description: A year's holidays and early closes.

name: market_hours

outputSchema.description: now is the market's state with the next open and close; date, year and trading_days answer the arguments given.

title: Market hours and holidays (NYSE, Nasdaq)
